[size=4]Transform your mines into a sweet wonderland with candy-themed mine nodes! Sweet Mines adds delicious-looking ore nodes that will make mining a more colorful and tasty experience.[/size]


Sweet Mines is a Content Patcher / Item Extensions pack that transforms the standard mine nodes into delicious candy-themed alternatives. If you've ever wanted to mine candies instead of boring stones and ores, this mod is for you! You can eat these tasty treats to get different buffs and effects.


[center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/pnXpdAc.png[/img]﻿

[/center][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions[/url]﻿ & dependencies.
[*]Download using Vortex.
[/list]
[center][b]OR[/b]﻿[/center]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions[/url]﻿ & dependencies.
[*]Download Sweet Mines
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ojiuuLc.png[/img]﻿[/center]

Sweet Mines is designed to be simple and straightforward. There's no complex configuration needed - just install and enjoy!

However, if you wish you can configure spawn levels in the config json file in the mod folders. Alternatively if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] you can configure it there.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ha9Sqrl.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[list]
[*][b]Candy-Themed Ore Nodes[/b] - Mine nodes are transformed into various candy-themed versions
[*][b]Complete Visual Overhaul[/b] - All mine nodes have been redesigned to match the sweet theme
[*][b]Vanilla-Friendly[/b] - The mod only changes appearances, all game mechanics remain unchanged
[*][b]Performance-Friendly[/b] - Minimal impact on game performance
[*][b]Compatibility[/b] - Works with most other mods unless they modify the same mine textures
[/list]

[center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/N37Pcgu.png[/img]﻿[/center]

Sweet Mines should be compatible with most mods. However, it may conflict with:

[list]
[*]Other mods that change mine node textures
[*]Texture replacers that modify mining-related assets
[/list]

[b]Warning:[/b] If you use multiple mine node replacement mods, the one loaded last will take precedence. Check your SMAPI console for any potential conflicts.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/H1SaLUN.png[/img]﻿[/center]

I'm actively working on expanding Sweet Mines with more features. Here's what you can look forward to in future updates:

[list]
[*][b]More Varieties[/b] - Additional candy types and designs
[*][b]Configuration Options[/b] - More customization options to tailor your experience
[*][b]Integration with ProfitCalculator[/b] - Special candy-specific profit calculations
[*][b]Furniture [/b]- Use your treats to craft special furniture to decorate your farm with!
[*][b]Full Versions of treats [/b]- Craft Full versions of treats for extra buffs and effects, including a special cake!
[/list]

Stay tuned for these exciting updates!
